div.head: Cn 1027 9
div.ab: Quapropter Deo omnipotenti gratias magnificas reddo, quia omnia, quae desideraveram prout mente decreveram, prospere perfeci votisque meis ad velle satisfeci.

Therefore, I render supreme thanks to Almighty God, because, in accordance with my intention, I have successfully accomplished all that I had desired, and have fulfilled my vows in accordance with my wish.
Therefore I give most hearty thanks to Almighty God, that I have successfully accomplished all that I had desired, just as I had designed, and have carried out my vows to my satisfaction.
div.note: Latin only (Cnut's letter of 1027, c. May; Latin translation c. 1070–1100, the Old English original is lost). Liebermann's text is from Florence of Worcester (ed. MGH SS XIII 126), compared with Ox (Oxford, Corpus 157 p. 329) and William of Malmesbury II 183; text in column T. Liebermann gives no German translation.
